tips: Fa kɔla abien ma sɛ wobɛpaw bi sen sɛ wobɛpaw set no nyinaa sɛ paw no te sɛ nea ɛboro so a.
Wɔma nnua a ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ ne owia bruu akwaaba. Eyi fa kɔla a wobenya mu anigye ho, na ɛnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ ho.
Nkratafa a wɔatintim no de agyiraehyɛde a ɛyɛ den anaa krayola a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛkyere no yɛ adwuma yiye.

faq.q: So bere nhyehyɛe anaasɛ nkontaahyɛde bi wɔ hɔ?
faq.a: Dabi, dɔn, nkontabuo, move counter anaa nkogudi biara nni hɔ. Wubetumi agyina bere biara, na sɛ wugyina fã a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a edi mũ a wobɛfa so awie.

faq.q: So nkratafa yi yɛ mmofra de dodo?
faq.a: Yɛyɛɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ komm na ɛnyɛ den ho mfonini sen sɛ yɛbɛyɛ mfoninitwa mfiri, enti nkratafa no fata mpanyimfo. Nneɛma akɛse a wɔayɛ no ma kɔla yɛ mmerɛw a ɛmma ɛnyɛ nkokoaa.

faq.q: So ɛyɛ nea wontua hwee, na so ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Yiw, wontua hwee, na akontaabu, sign-up anaa download biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɛb brawsa mu wɔ fon, tablɛt anaa kɔmputa so.

conversation-cards.name: Nkɔmmɔbɔ nkrataa
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wɔde Fi Ase Ma Dementia: Mfonini Kaad
conversation-cards.description: Mfonini nkrataa a wɔde nkɔmmɔbɔ fi ase brɛoo ma nnipa a wɔte adwenemhaw: nsɛmmisa biara nni hɔ, mmuae a ɛfata biara nni hɔ.
conversation-cards.short: Mfonini nkrataa a nsɛmmisa a wɔabue ano na ɛyɛ brɛoo wom. Nsɛmmisa biara nni hɔ.
conversation-cards.intro: Kaad biara de mfonini a wunim no yiye ne nsato krataa a wɔabue ano sɛ wɔmmɛkasa, te sɛ "Wim tebea bɛn na w'ani gye ho paa?" Mmuae a ɛteɛ biara nni hɔ na biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkae. Paw asɛmti bi anaasɛ frafra ne nyinaa mu.
howTo: Paw asɛmti bi, anaa fa "All cards" sie.
Kenkan asɛmmisa no den na mobom hwɛ mfonini no.
Tie, ka w’ankasa mmuae, na ma ɔkasa no kyinkyin.
Klik "Next card" so bere a woasiesie wo ho no, anaa tra kaad biako so bere tenten biara a wopɛ.
Klik "Print all cards" so na twa krataa bi a wɔahyehyɛ.
tips: W’ankasa nso bua asɛmmisa no. Ɛte sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ, ɛnyɛ nsɛmbisa.
Di asɛm no akyi, na ɛnyɛ nokwasɛm ahorow no. Sɛ nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri sesa a, ɛnyɛ papa.
Sɛ kaad bi ka biribi a ɛyɛ awerɛhow a, gye nkate no tom na fa brɛoo kɔ kaad foforo so.

faq.q: Adɛn nti na "Wokae...?" nsɛmmisa?
faq.a: Nsɛmmisa a ɛsɔ nkae hwɛ betumi ate nka sɛ sɔhwɛ na ɛde aniwu aba. Bue nsato krataa te sɛ "Tell me about..." ma obiara mfa ne ho nhyɛ mu, nea ɔkae biara.

faq.q: So metumi atintim nkrataa no?
faq.a: Aane. "Print all cards" tintim set no nyinaa wɔ type kɛse mu, cards pii wɔ kratafa biara mu, a wɔasiesie sɛ wobetwa.

faq.q: So ɛyɛ nea wontua hwee, na so ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Yiw, wontua hwee, na akontaabu, sign-up anaa download biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɛb brawsa mu wɔ fon, tablɛt anaa kɔmputa so.

photo-pairs.name: Mfonini abien abien
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Yɛ Agorudi a ɛne ne ho hyia fi Abusua Mfonini ahorow mu
photo-pairs.description: Dane w’ankasa abusua mfonini ahorow ma ɛnyɛ agoru a ɛne ne ho hyia brɛoo. Paw mfonini 2 kosi 6 wɔ wo mfiri no so; wɔtra wo browser no mu na wɔmfa nkɔ da.
photo-pairs.short: Paw w’ankasa mfonini ahorow na ma ɛne no hyia. Wɔmfa biribiara nkɔ upload.
photo-pairs.intro: Paw mfonini abien kosi asia fi wo fon, tablɛt anaa kɔmputa so, na ɛbɛyɛ agoru a ɛne ne ho hyia a mfonini akɛse a wotumi hu wom. Wɔakyerɛ mfonini ahorow no wɔ kratafa yi mu nkutoo. Wɔmfa nkɔ, wɔmfa nsie anaasɛ wɔmfa nkyɛ, na sɛ woto krataafa no mu a, ɛyera.
howTo: Klik "Choose photos" na paw mfonini abien kosi asia.
Mfonini biara pue mprenu. Klik biako so, afei pia ne abien no.
Ka mfonini biara ho asɛm sɛnea wuhu no.
Sɛ wowie a, to krataafa no mu anaa pia "Clear photos". Wɔmfa biribiara nsie.
tips: Paw nneɛma a ɛyɛ anigye, a wunim ho mfonini a emu da hɔ: afieboa, turo, beae a w’ani gye ho, ayeforohyia da.
Mmeae ne nneɛma ho mfonini betumi ayɛ mmerɛw asen anim, na ɛkwati nhyɛso biara a ɛbɛma wɔabɔ nnipa din.
Gyae nnipa a wɔawuwu mfonini sɛ ebia ɛde awerɛhow mpofirim bɛba a, gye sɛ wunim sɛ ɛde awerɛkyekye ba.

faq.q: So wɔde me mfonini ahorow akɔ baabiara?
faq.a: Dabi, kratafa no kenkan mfonini ahorow a woapaw no tẽẽ wɔ wo browser no mu na ɛkyerɛ wɔ wo screen so. Wɔmfa nkɔma yɛn anaa obi foforo biara, na sɛ woto kratafa no mu anaasɛ wosan de gu mu a, ɛyera.

faq.q: So bere nhyehyɛe anaasɛ nkontaahyɛde bi wɔ hɔ?
faq.a: Dabi, dɔn, nkontabuo, move counter anaa nkogudi biara nni hɔ. Wubetumi agyina bere biara, na sɛ wugyina fã a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a edi mũ a wobɛfa so awie.

faq.q: So metumi de agoru no asie ama bere foforo?
faq.a: Ɛnyɛ browser no mu, sɛnea wɔayɛ no, enti wɔmfa kokoam biribiara nsie. Golden Moments app a wontua hwee a ɛwɔ iPhone ne iPad so no betumi de mfonini ahorow a wɔapaw asie wo mfiri no so.

picture-bingo.name: Mfonini bingo
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Mfonini Bingo ma Nkwakoraa ne mmerewa a wɔwɔ adwenemhaw: Wotumi tintim
picture-bingo.description: Mfonini bingo a wotumi tintim a wontua hwee ma nkae a wɔhwɛ ne akuw a wɔn mfe akɔ anim, a obi kɛse a ɔfrɛ wɔ screen so ka ho.
picture-bingo.short: Mfonini bingo kaad a wotumi tintim ne screen kɛse a ɛfrɛ akuw.
picture-bingo.intro: Classic bingo a mfonini ahorow wom sen nɔma, enti enhia sɛ obiara kenkan nkyerɛwee nketewa. Print kaad soronko bi, afei fa on-screen caller no kyerɛ mfonini biara kɛse wɔ TV, laptop anaa tablet so.
howTo: Paw ahinanan 9 anaa 16 wɔ kaad biara mu ne agodifo dodow.
Klik "Print cards" so. Ɛsono kaad biara.
Bue nea ɔfrɛ no no wɔ screen kɛse bi so. Klik "Next picture" so na kyerɛ mfonini biara ne ne din.
Agodifo de sika, bɔtn anaa agyiraehyɛde kata mfonini a ɛne no hyia a ɛwɔ wɔn kaad so no so.
Obiara a ɔhyɛ toatoa so, anaa kaad no nyinaa ma no nya anigye. Wɔn a wɔadi nkogu biara nni saa nkyerɛase yi mu: kɔ so di agoru kosi sɛ obiara benya line.
tips: Fa token akɛse te sɛ checkers anaa bottle caps di dwuma. Ebetumi ayɛ den sɛ wobɛfa bɔton nketewa.
Bobɔ mfonini no din na ka biribi fa ho: "Ahyɛmma a wɔde po so hyɛn tu. Hena na wakɔ akɔtena hyɛmma mu?"
Fa nnipa a ɛyɛ den sɛ wobehu wɔn a wɔbɛn screen no tena ase, na fa aboafo ne agodifo a wohia wɔn bom.
Ahinanan akron dɔɔso ma akuw dodow no ara. Ma adesua no nyɛ simma 20 kosi 30.

faq.q: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi atu mmirika wɔ picture bingo mu wɔ fie a wɔhwɛ wɔn?
faq.a: Print kaad biako wɔ obiara a ɔbɔ bɔɔl no mu, fa nea ɔfrɛ no no to screen kɛse a wowɔ no so, na frɛ mfonini ahorow no nkakrankakra, bɔ emu biara din. Di agorɔ kɔsi sɛ obiara bɛnya line, enti wɔrennyaw obiara.

faq.q: So ɛyɛ nea wontua hwee sɛ wobetintim?
faq.a: Aane. Print nkrataa dodow biara a wuhia, mpɛn dodow biara a wopɛ, ma w’ankasa anaa kuw de di dwuma.

faq.q: So nkurɔfo betumi adi agoru a wɔnkenkan ade?
faq.a: Aane. Ahinanan biara yɛ mfonini kɛse, na wɔde ne din ahyɛ ase ma wɔn a wɔpɛ nsɛmfua.

calm-breathing.name: Ɔhome a ɛyɛ komm
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Ahomegye a Ɛyɛ Dwo Ma Nkwakoraa ne mmerewa ne Wɔn a Wɔhwɛ Wɔn
calm-breathing.description: Ahomegye a ɛyɛ brɛoo na ɛyɛ komm a wɔde kyɛ ade: kurukuruwa a ɛyɛ brɛoo nyin na ɛso tew ahome asia. Wofi ase, na wubetumi agyae bere biara.
calm-breathing.short: Kurukuruwa a ɛyɛ brɛoo a wobɛhome ka ho. Fi ase na gyae bere a wopɛ.
calm-breathing.intro: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, dwumadi a eye sen biara ne sɛ wobɛhome komm. Tap "Start", afei home bere a kurukuruwa no nyin na fi adi bere a ɛretew no. Paw ɔkwan a wobɛfa so akɔ brɛoo anaasɛ wobɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm. Ɛnyɛ ayaresa, asomdwoe bere a wɔde bɛkyɛ kɛkɛ.
howTo: Tena ase yiye wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn.
Paw ɔkwan a wobɛfa so: brɛoo anaasɛ brɛoo.
Klik "Fi ase" so. Hom home bere a kurukuruwa no nyin, na home bere a ɛretew no.
Ɛgyina n'ankasa bere a woahome asia akyi, anaasɛ pia "Gyina" bere biara a wopɛ.
tips: Mukura wo nsa anaa fa wo nsa to onipa no abasa so sɛ ɛyɛ akwaaba a.
Mma nnsi so dua da. Sɛ wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ a, ɛno ye.
Sɛ obi wɔ ɔhome mu haw a, home sɛnea ɛsɛ na hwɛ kurukuruwa no ara kwa. Bisa oduruyɛfo bi fa ɔhome ho haw biara ho.

faq.q: So eyi yɛ aduruyɛ mu ahomegye apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛyɛ home a ɛnyɛ den a obi betumi apaw a ɛbɛma woayɛ komm na woayɛ fekubɔ. Ɛnyɛ dadwen anaa tebea biara a wɔde sa yare. Wo ne oduruyɛfo nkasa mfa akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho.

faq.q: So kurukuruwa no tu a memfa mfi ase?
faq.a: Dabi Biribiara ntumi nkɔ kosi sɛ wobɛbɔ Start, na egyina bere a woahome asia akyi anaasɛ bere a woabɔ Stop no. Sɛ wɔahyɛ wo mfiri no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛtew kankyee so a, nsɛmfua no sesa a kurukuruwa no nnyin.

faq.q: So ɛyɛ nea wontua hwee, na so ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Yiw, wontua hwee, na akontaabu, sign-up anaa download biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɛb brawsa mu wɔ fon, tablɛt anaa kɔmputa so.
